result.output:
# Crashtest

**Find the bugs your users would hit, before they hit them.**

Most bugs that reach users are not in code nobody tested. They are in paths nobody walked: rejecting instead of approving, the empty account, the second tab, someone else's id in the URL. Crashtest is a macOS app with an autonomous agent that walks those paths for you.

Give it a GitHub repo and it:

1. **Maps the app from its code** — screens, actions, API operations, background jobs, integrations, roles, entity lifecycles, limits.
2. **Writes every scenario a user can do or live through**, ranked P1–P3 and grouped by user journey.
3. **Runs them for real** — clones the app, boots it on your Mac or on your own server (VDS), drives it in a browser, and reports what broke with a screenshot, the root cause at `file:line`, and a suggested diff. It never edits your code.

Built during [neatHack](https://neatlogs.com/hackathon) (Oct 10–12, 2026). Build log: [hackathon.md](hackathon.md).

## What it found on its first real target

On [TonyMckes/conduit-realworld-example-app](https://github.com/TonyMckes/conduit-realworld-example-app), a well-known RealWorld implementation, Crashtest wrote 245 scenarios, booted the app from scratch (local Postgres, generated `.env`, API + frontend) and found, among others:

- **A comment can be deleted through any article's URL** — `backend/controllers/comments.js` ignores the slug.
- **Users can follow themselves** — `backend/controllers/profiles.js` never compares ids.
- `DEV_DB_LOGGING="false"` crashes the app at boot, because the string `"false"` is truthy.

Details, diffs and screenshots: [docs/evidence/findings-conduit.md](docs/evidence/findings-conduit.md).

## How it works

```
GitHub link ─► Intake ─► Inventory agent ─► Scenario writer ─► [Start] ─► Local │ VDS
               clone,     Sonnet 5.5,        Haiku 5.5,                     │
               products   read-only tools    parallel per journey           ▼
                                                              Bootstrap agent ─► Sweep agent
                                                              boots the app      one scenario at a time,
                                                              (shell, logs,      Playwright browser + API,
                                                              ports, recovery)   verdict + root cause + diff
```

- **Agents** run on the [Claude Agent SDK](https://docs.claude.com/en/api/agent-sdk/overview) with a per-phase tool set: the inventory agent can only read; the bootstrap and sweep agents operate the app through Crashtest's own MCP tools (`shell`, `start_background`, `read_log`, `expose_port`, `http_get`).
- **Local and VDS are the same to the agent.** Both runtimes implement those tools; the VDS runtime works over SSH and tunnels the app's ports back so the browser on your Mac can drive it.
- **Recovery.** If the app stops answering mid-run, Crashtest restarts it with the commands the bootstrap agent used and carries on. Services run in the foreground and are always stopped at the end, even if you quit mid-run.
- **Chat.** Ask about the app, hand over `.env` values or server details (stored encrypted in the macOS Keychain), or start a run from the conversation.
npm run dev

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/evidence/findings-conduit.md'; s=open(p).read()
head="""# Crashtest findings — TonyMckes/conduit-realworld-example-app

## Full P1 run — 2026-10-10 01:26–02:18 PDT

Fresh analysis (latest build, new user data): **294 scenarios across 9 journeys** (114 P1 · 128 P2 · 52 P3) in 143 s. Then every P1 scenario, run locally in one go, app booted from scratch by the bootstrap agent:

**✅ 80 passed · ❌ 33 broken · ⏭ 1 skipped — 114 scenarios in 52 minutes.**

The 33 broken scenarios trace back to **12 files**. The biggest groups:

| File | Broken scenarios | What is wrong |
|---|---|---|
| `backend/middleware/authentication.js` | 9 | Any invalid, forged or expired JWT ends in a **500** (the `jwtVerify` error falls through to the generic handler) instead of a 401, and the frontend lands on "not found" instead of asking to sign in. |
| `backend/helper/jwt.js` | 5 | Tokens are signed **without an expiry** and cannot be revoked: a token keeps working after logout and after a password change. |
| `backend/controllers/user.js` | 4 | **Saving settings with a blank password replaces the user's password** — `if (password !== undefined \\|\\| password !== "")` is always true (`&&` was meant). Also no length check, and username/email can be changed to ones another account already uses. |
| `backend/controllers/articles.js` | 3 | Negative or non-numeric `limit`/`offset` → 500 with raw DB errors, and no cap on `limit`; renaming an article to an existing title creates a duplicate slug. |
| `backend/controllers/users.js` | 3 | Duplicate usernames are accepted at sign-up (201), duplicate-email error has the wrong shape, no rate limit on login. |

Plus: double-clicking Publish creates two articles, the Post Comment button is not disabled while posting, a user can follow themselves, and two simultaneous sign-ups with one email create two accounts.

We checked the top three against the source by hand: `controllers/user.js:36` (the `||`), `middleware/authentication.js` (errors passed to `next(error)` → 500) and `models/User.js` (`username` has no unique constraint). All three are real.

Every finding, with expected/actual, root cause at `file:line` and a suggested diff, grouped by file: **[findings-conduit-p1-full.md](findings-conduit-p1-full.md)**. Scenario list after the run: [conduit-p1-scenarios.png](conduit-p1-scenarios.png).

---

## First local run — 2026-10-10 00:27 PDT
"""
s=s.replace("# Crashtest findings — TonyMckes/conduit-realworld-example-app\n\nFirst local run, 2026-10-10 00:27 PDT.","\n".join([head])+"\n",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

- cfo.ai: iş planı kuruldu (fiyat, maliyet, gelir, nakit, 3 senaryo). Herkese açık okuma linki var. Bkz. [[Crashtest]].
- Uygulamada bulunan ve düzeltilen hata: senaryo yazan yapay zekâ bazen eksik senaryo döndürüyordu ve tüm analiz çöküyordu → artık eksikler atlanıyor.
- Yeni özellik: bulunan bug'lar hangi dosyadan geldiğine göre gruplanıyor ve FINDINGS.md raporu yazılıyor.
- Büyük test: Conduit uygulamasında 294 senaryo yazıldı. 114 önemli (P1) senaryo çalıştırıldı: 80 geçti, 33 bug, 1 atlandı. Bug'lar 12 dosyada toplanıyor. En ciddisi: ayarlarda şifre boş bırakılınca kullanıcının şifresi siliniyor.
- İkinci repo (kutt) da analiz edildi: 359 senaryo.

**Testler sırasında app'te bulup düzelttiğim hatalar**
- **Analiz çöküyordu:** yapay zekâ bazen eksik alanlı bir senaryo döndürüyordu ve bu tüm analizi düşürüyordu. Artık eksik olanlar atlanıyor.
- **Güvenlik:** test ajanı bir senaryoda Mac'te `pkill` çalıştırdı. Artık bu tür geniş süreç öldürme komutları engelleniyor; ajan sadece kendi başlattığı süreçleri durdurabiliyor. Aynı senaryoyu tekrar koşturdum, ajan yeni yolu kullandı.
- **Pencere çökmesi:** 72 dakikalık bir koşuda app penceresi çöktü ve koşu yarıda kaldı. Artık pencere kendini otomatik yeniliyor; bilerek çökertip test ettim. Yarım kalan 9 senaryoyu yeni sürümle tamamladım.
- **Yeni özellik:** koşu sonunda bug'lar hangi dosyadan geldiğine göre gruplanıyor ve `FINDINGS.md` raporu yazılıyor.
